data.investment_objective:
The investment objective of the scheme is to generate capital appreciation and 
income by predominantly investing in arbitrage opportunities in the cash and the 
derivative segments of the equity markets and the arbitrage opportunities available 
within the derivative segment and by investing the balance in debt and money market 
instruments. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will 
be achieved.
data.asset_allocation:
Equity & Equity related instruments including derivatives (index futures, stock futures, 
index options and stock options, etc) :- 65-100%
Debt (including securitised debt) & Money Market instruments including the margin 
money deployed in derivative transactions*:- 0-35%
Units issued by REITs and InvITs:- 0-10%
*Debt securities / instruments are deemed to include securitized debt and investment 
in securitized debt will not exceed 50% of the debt portion of the scheme in 
accordance with clause 1 of Seventh Schedule of SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations, 
1996.
data.exit_load:
0.25% if redeemed/switched out on or before completion of 1 month from the date of 
allotment of units. No Exit Load is payable if Units are redeemed / switched-out after 
1 month from the date of allotment.
No exit load shall be applicable on switches from Regular Plan to Direct Plan and vice 
versa, under the same scheme.
